articles.title: 5-vehicle collision leads to major delays on DVP, Gardiner Expressway
articles.summary: A five-vehicle collision led to major traffic delays on the Don Valley Parkway (DVP) leading into the Gardiner Expressway on Saturday night. Emergency crews were called to the DVP, near Gerrard Street East, just before 7 p.m. At least two people were transported to a hospital. The extent of their injuries was not immediately known. […]

articles.title: Multiple people injured in Aurora car crash
articles.summary: Multiple people were injured Saturday evening in a car crash that happened in Aurora. Emergency crews were called to Wellington and Bathurst Streets in York Region just before 8 p.m. for reports of a three-vehicle collision. Police say two people were injured. The condition of the victims was not immediately known. Roads in the area […]

articles.title: Toronto peace groups host downtown march against gun violence
articles.summary: Two Toronto peace organizations held a community march against gun violence in the city’s downtown core Saturday, following the fatal shooting of a 17-year-old earlier this week.

articles.title: Former Toronto Raptor Kyle Lowry awarded key to city, statue at Jurassic Park
articles.summary: Former Toronto Raptor Kyle Lowry was awarded a key to the city at a block party downtown Saturday, recognizing his contributions to the community on and off the court.

articles.title: Kyle Lowry awarded key to the city of Toronto
articles.summary: Kyle Lowry has been handed one of Toronto’s biggest honours: a key to the city. articles.title: Woman wanted in 40-plus vehicle break-ins across Mississauga
articles.summary: Police in Peel Region are searching for a 33-year-old woman in connection with more than 40 vehicle break‑ins across Mississauga earlier this month.

articles.title: MS NOW, CNN and Politico say their journalists were denied access to White House after Trump ban
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Reporters from three major news organizations — CNN, MS NOW and Politico — were denied access to the White House on Saturday, a day after President Donald Trump said he was barring them because of reporting he found to be “fake news.”

articles.title: Candidates in Toronto's east end are arguing over a Gardiner ramp that doesn't exist anymore
articles.summary: A years-gone ramp on the Gardiner Expressway is haunting the race for city councillor in Toronto’s east end, with some candidates saying another’s promise to resurrect it is just smoke and mirrors.

articles.title: Artists in Durham Region gear up for annual free festival featuring 'symphony' of arts
articles.summary: Artists across Durham Region are preparing for a free festival next month that’s in its 45th year of showcasing local talent.

articles.title: Motorcyclist, 74, dies after single-vehicle crash in Vaughan
articles.summary: A motorcyclist has died after a single-vehicle crash in Vaughan on Friday evening, Ontario provincial police say.

articles.title: Man, 61, dead after car and dump truck collide in Caledon, police say
articles.summary: A 61-year-old man is dead after a car and dump truck collided in Caledon early Friday, police say.
